en: Returns to the previous screen.
Choose a destination.
Saves the game.
This party suspended its adventure. It can resume.
note: Pattern follows ebt 'This party was wiped out. It cannot resume.'

en: This is your current party. It cannot resume.
This is the event list.
Sets the in-game BGM volume.
Sets the in-game SE (sound effect) volume.
note: SE kept as on the option label; expanded once for clarity.

en: Turns the help message animation on or off.
Sets the conversation message speed in 5 steps. 1 is the slowest and 5 is the fastest.
Sets whether the cursor position is remembered.
Sets whether nicknames are shown on the party panel.
Sets whether HP/AC are shown on the party panel.
Sets blue as the transparent color for images imported with Face Load.
note: Face Load (feature name) romanized from the katakana; same family as Style/Sound/Dungeon Load.

en: Turns the in-game hurt SE on or off.
note: yarare SE = sound played when a character is hit/downed; rendered 'hurt SE'. Unverified in game.

en: Sets the SE for the adventurers' side.
Sets the SE for the monsters' side.
Sets how effects are displayed during battle.
Sets the battle message speed in 5 steps. 1 is the slowest and 5 is the fastest.
note: Source says only 'message speed'; designer note and Battle tab confirm it is the battle message speed, so 'battle' added to tell it apart from row 704.

en: Renames each of the spells the player can use.
Sets whether enemy spell names are renamed as well.
Sets the display format of the battle log.
Sets the names shown in the battle log.
Summoner spell names cannot be changed.
Sets whether follow-up monsters are shown when they appear.
note: koezoku = monsters arriving after the first group (cf. ebt 'More monsters were called in').

en: Sets what happens when you press Down on the directional buttons.
Turns the movement animation on or off.
Shows or hides the clock.
Shows or hides the party panel.
Sets which direction is at the top of the minimap.
Sets the size of the minimap.
Resets all options, including spell name changes, to their defaults.
Configures general settings.
Configures settings mainly used in battle.
Configures settings mainly used in dungeons.
Resets all settings to their defaults.
Configures Face/Style Load settings.
Sets whether characters with serious status ailments are automatically admitted for treatment when they return to town.
note: nyuuin (hospitalization): healing happens at Rust Temple, but source does not name it, so 'admitted for treatment' is used.

en: When importing BMP data for Face Load, sets whether blue is treated as the transparent color.
When importing BMP data for Style Load, sets whether blue is treated as the transparent color.
Sets how style images are shown on the character status screen.
Sets how style images are shown on the battle screen.
Imports Face Load data from the Memory Stick.
note: The trailing bar glyph after Memory Stick (trademark mark in the JP font) is dropped, as in the ebt translations.

en: Imports Style Load data from the Memory Stick.
note: Bar glyph dropped as in row 738.

en: Imports Sound Load data from the Memory Stick.
note: Bar glyph dropped as in row 738.

en: Imports Dungeon Load data from, and exports it to, the Memory Stick.
note: Spelling 'Dungeon Load' follows the majority of existing ebt/chap rows (3 'Load' vs 2 'Road' in ebt slice_07); flag for a corpus-wide check. Bar glyph dropped.

en: Installs the game data.
Enters the password for the Book of the Next Age.
Select a slot to import into. Square: swap data. Triangle: delete data.
Select the data to import.
Select the track to replace. Triangle: restore the original setting.
Select the sound data to import.
Select the playback volume to set.
Use Up/Down to set the playback volume. Triangle: restore the original setting.
Select the data to work with.
Exports the selected data to the transfer folder. Any data already in the transfer folder will be lost.
Imports the data in the transfer folder. Any data in the selected slot will be lost.
Enters a password.
Please enter the password.
Settings for using the effects of the Book of the Next Age.
Sets up the compass.
Views the Key Items you are carrying.
Searches the dungeon for parties that suspended their adventure or were wiped out.
Offers Fame to the compass.
Either you lack Fame, or there are no rings within the search range.
The compass seems to be set to All Altars.
note: Source frames the target with spaces like the ebt '%s' template; 'All Altars' capitalized as a target name.

en: Sets the search target.
This is the list of your Key Items.

note: nakama rendered 'companion' (cf. pilot 'companions'); this menu finds stranded parties.
